tools.name: list_deadline_rules
tools.description: List the court deadline types 1Court can calculate for a jurisdiction. Available ids: TX; CA (civil), CA-FAM (family), CA-PROB (probate), CA-UD (unlawful detainer), CA-SC (small claims), CA-GOV (government claims), CA-APP (appeals and writs); US (federal civil and appellate), US-BK (bankruptcy). Add

tools.name: calculate_deadline
tools.description: Calculate a court deadline deterministically from cited rules (weekends, legal holidays, short-period and mail-service rules applied). Returns the date, each computation step, and the rule text and source. Always show the user the citation and caveats; this is not legal advice.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List all U.S. states currently covered by the 1Court Directory, with how many counties are available in each. Use this to discover coverage before looking up a specific county.

tools.name: list_counties
tools.description: List the counties covered in a given U.S. state (accepts a full state name, 2-letter code, or slug). Returns each county name and its 1Court page URL.

tools.name: get_court_info
tools.description: Get verified court information for a specific U.S. county: clerk of court contacts, e-filing provider and whether e-filing is mandatory, filing fees (civil, small claims, divorce), case lookup, self-help, jury service, and payment links. Data is sourced from official court/clerk records. Always cite

tools.name: search_courts
tools.description: Search the 1Court Directory by county or state name and get matching counties with their 1Court page URLs. Use when you are unsure of the exact county or state format.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_court_info" stacks urgency/override words (always, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
